# V850 against `v850-elf-as` with no -m option: the original V850 instruction
# set. One statement per line; `#` lines are comments.

# ---- registers and their ABI names
mov r1, r2
mov R1, R2
mov r31, r30
mov zero, hp
mov sp, gp
mov tp, ep
mov lp, r31
mov r0, r1

# ---- format I: register to register
add r1, r2
sub r1, r2
cmp r1, r2
and r3, r4
or r3, r4
xor r3, r4
not r3, r4
tst r3, r4
subr r3, r4
mulh r1, r2
divh r1, r2
satadd r1, r2
satsub r1, r2
satsubr r1, r2
jmp [r1]
jmp r1
jmp [lp]
nop
breakpoint

# ---- format II: 5-bit immediates, and the range GNU as accepts for them
mov 5, r2
mov -16, r10
mov 15, r10
add 3, r2
add -16, r2
add 16, r2
add 31, r2
cmp -1, r2
cmp 15, r31
satadd 5, r2
satadd -16, r2
mulh 5, r2
mulh -1, r2
shl 5, r6
shr 31, r6
sar 0, r6
sar 17, r29

# ---- format IV: short loads and stores relative to ep
sld.b 5[ep], r1
sld.b 127[ep], r1
sld.b -1[ep], r1
sld.b 5[r30], r1
sld.h 6[ep], r2
sld.h 254[ep], r2
sld.w 8[ep], r2
sld.w 252[ep], r2
sst.b r1, 5[ep]
sst.h r1, 6[ep]
sst.w r1, 8[ep]
sst.w r31, 0[ep]

# ---- format VI: 16-bit immediates
movea 5, r1, r2
movea -1, r1, r2
movea 0xffff, r1, r2
movea 0x8000, r1, r2
movea -32768, r1, r2
movhi 0x1234, r0, r1
addi 100, r1, r2
addi -100, r0, r31
andi 0xffff, r1, r2
andi -1, r1, r2
ori 0x8000, r1, r2
xori 1, r1, r2
mulhi 3, r1, r2
satsubi 5, r1, r2

# ---- hi(), lo() and hi0() on constants; hi() carries bit 15 of the low half
movhi hi(0x12345678), r0, r1
movhi hi(0x12348000), r0, r2
movhi hi(0x12347fff), r0, r2
movhi hi(0x1234ffff), r0, r2
movhi hi0(0x12348000), r0, r2
movhi hi(-1), r0, r2
movhi hi(0x7fff8000), r0, r2
movea lo(0x12348000), r1, r2
movea lo(0x12347fff), r1, r2
movea lo(-1), r1, r2
movea hi(0x12348000), r1, r2
movea zdaoff(0xfffff006), r0, r1

# ---- format VII: 16-bit displacements
ld.b 5[r1], r2
ld.b -5[r1], r2
ld.b 0x7fff[r1], r2
ld.b -0x8000[r1], r2
ld.h 6[r1], r2
ld.w 8[r1], r2
ld.w -8[sp], lp
st.b r2, 5[r1]
st.h r2, 6[r1]
st.w r2, 8[r1]
st.w lp, 0[sp]
ld.b 5 [ r1 ] , r2
ld.b lo(0x12348000)[r1], r2
ld.w lo(0x12348002)[r1], r2

# ---- format V: jumps with a numeric displacement
jarl 0, r31
jarl 2, lp
jarl -2, r1
jarl 0x1ffffe, r1
jarl -0x200000, r1
jr 100
jr -100

# ---- format III: conditional branches with a numeric displacement
bz 8
bz -2
bz 0xfe
bz -0x100
br 6
bsa 4
bgt 6
bge 6
blt 6
ble 6
bh 6
bnh 6
bl 6
bnl 6
be 6
bne 6
bv 6
bnv 6
bn 6
bp 6
bc 6
bnc 6
bz 6
bnz 6
bt 6
bf 6
bsa 6
jbr 6
jgt 6
jge 6
jlt 6
jle 6
jh 6
jnh 6
jl 6
jnl 6
je 6
jne 6
jv 6
jnv 6
jn 6
jp 6
jc 6
jnc 6
jz 6
jnz 6

# ---- format VIII: bit manipulation
set1 3, 5[r1]
clr1 3, 5[r1]
not1 3, 5[r1]
tst1 7, -1[r1]
set1 7, 0xffff[r1]
set1 0, -32768[r31]

# ---- format IX/X: shifts by register, conditions, system registers, control
shl r1, r2
shr r1, r2
sar r1, r2
setf z, r1
setf nz, r1
setf sa, r1
setf Z, r1
setf 5, r1
setf ge, r1
setf v, r31
setf nh, r2
ldsr r1, psw
ldsr r1, 5
ldsr r1, eipc
ldsr r1, sr31
stsr psw, r1
stsr eipc, r1
stsr 5, r1
stsr fepsw, r31
trap 0
trap 31
reti
halt
di
ei
